static country(code: str) → str[source]

Converts a given country code to its corresponding country name using a predefined dictionary of country codes and names. If the code does not exist in the dictionary, it returns “Unknown”.

Parameters:

code (str) – The country code provided as a string.

Returns:

The name of the country corresponding to the given code, or “Unknown” if the code is not found.

Return type:

str

static geographic_middle_point(coords)[source]

Calculates the geographic middle point (latitude and longitude) from a list of coordinate points. Each point must have ‘x’ and ‘y’ attributes representing latitude and longitude respectively.

Parameters:

coords – A list of geographic coordinate points where each point has ‘x’ as latitude and ‘y’ as longitude. :type coords: list

Returns:

The geographic middle point as a tuple containing latitude and longitude in degrees. If the input list is empty, returns None.

Return type:

tuple | None

static get_country_code(country: str) → str | None[source]

Returns the country code corresponding to the given country name, if found.

The method searches through a predefined dictionary of country codes and names to find a match by comparing the lowercase version of the given country name with the stored country names.

Parameters:

country – The name of the country to look up the country code for. The name comparison is case-insensitive. Type should be str.

Returns:

The country code corresponding to the provided country name if a match is found. If no match is found, returns None.

Return type:

str | None

static get_lat_lon(address: str) → tuple[float, float] | tuple[None, None][source]

Fetches the latitude and longitude coordinates for a given address using the Nominatim API. If the address is found in the API’s database, it returns the latitude and longitude as a tuple of floats. If the address is not found or the API returns no results, it returns a tuple containing two None values.

Parameters:

address (str) – The address string for which latitude and longitude are to be retrieved. Should be a descriptive location name or address interpretable by the Nominatim API.

Returns:

A tuple containing the latitude and longitude as floats if the address is found. Otherwise, returns a tuple with two None values.

Return type:

tuple[float, float] | tuple[None, None]

async static get_lat_lon_async(address: str) → tuple[float, float] | tuple[None, None][source]

Asynchronous method to fetch latitude and longitude for a given address by using the Nominatim OpenStreetMap API.

This method performs an HTTP GET request to query the geocoding service for a specified address and retrieves the latitude and longitude if available. It ensures compliance with Nominatim’s requirements by including a User-Agent in the request headers.

Parameters:

address (str) – The address string for which the latitude and longitude need to be fetched.

Returns:

A tuple containing latitude and longitude as floating-point numbers if the operation is successful. If the operation fails or no data is found, it returns a tuple of (None, None).

Return type:

tuple[float, float] | tuple[None, None]

src.utils.point module

class src.utils.point.Point(*, x: float, y: float, description: str, summary: str, value: float = 0)[source]

Bases: object

Represents a point in a 2D coordinate system with additional descriptive attributes.

This class encapsulates x and y coordinates, along with a description, summary, and an optional value for a radius or magnitude. It provides properties for managing these attributes and methods to convert point data into lists.

Variables:

  • __x – X-coordinate of the point.

  • __y – Y-coordinate of the point.

  • __description – Descriptive text about the point.

  • __summary – Summary information related to the point.

  • __value_radius – Optional radius or magnitude value associated with the point.
